item.title: Poplog
item.description: We brought Poplog — the classic multi-language AI development environment (Pop-11, Prolog, Common Lisp, Standard ML) — natively onto Apple Silicon, Raspberry Pi 5, and RISC-V. Then we added a fifth language, a real ELIZA, native graphics, and a full benchmark suite.

item.title: We revived Poplog — natively on Apple Silicon, Raspberry Pi 5, and RISC-V
item.description: IoTone brought Poplog — the classic multi-language AI development environment — natively onto Apple Silicon, Raspberry Pi 5, and RISC-V, then added a fifth language (Forth), a faithful ELIZA, an experimental native graphics backend, a deep set of porting notes, and a full published benchmark suite.
